start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kya interesting lagta hai?

turns.reply: Kabir, dekhiye: rectangle ki length 50 m aur breadth 30 m hai. Perimeter ke liye kaun-kaun se sides jodenge, bolkar batayiye?

turns.line: sab bekaar lagta hai, koi mujhse baat nahi karta
turns.reply: Kabir, yeh bahut bhaari lag raha hai. Kya hua—aur kya aap abhi safe hain?
Theek hai Kabir. Agar koi baat pareshaan kare, trusted grown-up ko batayiye. Ab rectangle ki chaar sides ungli se trace karke gin lijiye—kitni sides hain?
Kabir, picture ko dekhiye: rectangle ki chaar sides hain—do 50 m aur do 30 m. Aap total sides gin kar boliye.
